title: Birth of Rama
english: Lord Rama was born in Ayodhya as the son of King Dasharatha and Queen Kausalya.

title: Exile
english: Rama willingly accepted fourteen years of exile to honor his father's promise.

title: Sita's Abduction
english: Ravana abducted Sita by deception while Rama and Lakshmana were away.

title: Hanuman Meets Rama
english: Hanuman met Lord Rama and became his greatest devotee.

title: Victory over Ravana
english: Lord Rama defeated Ravana and restored Dharma.
